summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine foreign private issuer, disclosed via Form 6-K that it and wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired treasury shares on 09/29/2026, settling 09/30/2026. CPSA bought 100,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at AR$1,951.31 per share, totaling AR$195,131,950; Proener bought 20,000 ADRs on NYSE at US$12.02 per ADR, totaling US$240,540.52, correcting a prior filing that showed US$12.22 and US$244,595.20. Combined purchases stayed below 25% of prior ninety-day average daily trading volume, a buyback-mechanics constraint rather than a tender offer.
